Fallen from Grace |quest_reward4_quest_id = a6q4 |quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Divine Ire''' is a [[channelling]] [[active skill gem]] that repeatedly damages nearby enemies while channelling to build up its charge quicker. Releasing the channel fires a beam of energy in front of the character, dealing [[physical damage]] [[damage conversion|converted]] to [[lightning damage]]. ==Skill functions and interactions== * '''[[Area of Effect]]''': Divine Ire's beam has a fixed length and width, though area damage modifiers from all sources still apply. The [[range]] of the zap while channelling can be affected by area modifiers (these zaps, though visually reminiscent of {{il|Arc}}, cannot [[chain]]). In addition to the beam, a small bubble of area damage also expands from the player upon skill release; this bubble is affected by AoE increases and decreases as normal. *'''Stages:''' 5 stacks for maximum width, 10 for maximum damage. *'''[[Totem]]s:''' When used by totems via {{il|Spell Totem Support}}, the totems will fully charge up to 10 stages before firing. They will continue doing so even if there are no more valid targets within range, if they began channelling while the targets were still in range. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Physical
Damage |c1_header = Deals x to y Physical Damage |c1_pattern_extract = Deals (%d+) to (%d+) Physical Damage |c1_pattern_value = %d to %d }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Alternate skill effect list}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.29.0| * Divine Ire: Now has 75% Effectiveness of Added Damage at gem level 20 (previously 50%), and now deals 321 to 482 Physical Damage at gem level 20 (previously 253 to 380). }} {{Version history table row|3.26.0| * Divine Ire: Now has 50% Effectiveness of Added Damage at all gem levels (previously 45%), and now deals 19 to 29 Physical Damage at gem level 1 (previously 17 to 25), scaling up to 253 to 380 at gem level 20 (previously 203 to 305). The Beam now deals 250% more Damage with Hits per Stage after the first (previously 240%), and deals 105% more Damage with Ailments per Stage after the first (previously 100%). }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Now has a maximum of 10 Stages. * The Beam now deals 240% more Damage with Hits per Stage after the first (previously 110%) and 100% more Damage with Ailments per Stage after the first (previously 30%). * It no longer has 50% less Damage while Channelling, 40% chance to gain an additional Stage when Hitting a Normal or Magic Enemy, or gains an additional Stage when Hitting a Rare or Unique Enemy. * Quality now provides 0-20% increased beam width, instead of 0-10% increased Area of Effect. }} {{Version history table row|3.17.0| * Divine Ire now deals 17 to 25 Physical Damage at gem level 1 (unchanged), up to 203 to 305 at gem level 20 (previously 140 to 210). * Now deals 110% more Damage with Hits per stage after the first (previously 100%). * Now has 45% Effectiveness of Added Damage at all gem levels (previously 30%). }} {{Version history table row|3.16.0| * Divine Ire now has “Beam deals 30% more Damage with Ailments per Stage after the first” (previously 70%). * Because of base Ignite damage changes, Ignite with the skill is now 7.1% higher at 20 Stages. }} {{Version history table row|3.6.3c| * Improved the visual indicator of Divine Ire's area of effect while channelling. }} {{Version history table row|3.6.0| * Divine Ire has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}}https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/ay564f/synthesis_gem_information/ehykn2k Stages {{Navbox Skills}}
